name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a precious metals royalty and streaming company focused exclusively on the state of Nevada, one of the world's premier gold mining jurisdictions. The company builds and manages a diversified portfolio of precious metal royalty interests and exploration properties, including the Agai-Pah property in Mineral County and the Swales property in Elko County. Nevada Canyon operates with low overhead relative to conventional mining companies and trades on the OTCQX Best Market.
